cases.query: For supplied mixed quantum preparations of a classical label, can I obtain the worst retained relative information even when external reference marginals change, without searching all references?
My estimated preparation matrices are nearly rank deficient, but any small full-rank contamination is possible. Can a finite universal reverse information factor survive that uncertainty?
An inverse quadratic form says my noncommuting prepared outputs are equivalent to perfectly readable labels at every matrix level. Is that enough to transfer the relative-entropy guarantee?
A correction loop reuses the actual syndrome register while its environment returns. Can physical accuracy help when a single unknown parameter already gives an exponential exact history span?

A low-rank target is sampled only as whole trajectories and a different teacher is close in global KL. I want a cached sequential sampler: are teacher draws alone enough, and what is the formal precision and noise cost?

I can prepare correlated elastic counters on each bond. Their equilibrium fluctuations look diffusive and total circulation is capped. Does this preserve ordinary relaxation of an order-one nonuniform density profile?

Native exchanges can atomically update one shared control bit, but I have no independent clock for that bit. With compatible actuated phase noise, can I still select a complete rare-transport history law?

An unknown smooth coercive angular witness is promised with margin and derivative bounds. How can a finite optimization acquire a certificate if the theorem it invokes requires an already known feasible center?
What exact recovery-learning cost is available when the noisy output is full rank but only a small part depends on the input? Can I already use the announced theorem as a quantitative premise?

I can either measure a quantum probe after every source call or keep it for a short consecutive block. For estimating a noisy channel's stationary state, how should that memory budget change the required source calls?

I have a proposed observable potential for an unknown quantum process, but no promised reset, mixing gap or unique stationary state. Can independent process probes certify the stationary observable anyway?
